description: Returns a published processing time for one form, category, and office. For US (the default), the USCIS processing-time estimate: the time within which 80% of cases were completed, in months, weeks, or days. Use it when the user asks for USCIS's published processing time for a form. It reports past completions, not how long a given case will take. Pass form, category, and office exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists them. Every US estimate on file has both a category and an office, so omitting either returns not_found. For Visa Bulletin waits, use get_visa_bulletin. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: for US, the USCIS processing times tool (egov.uscis.gov).

category.description: For US, the eligibility category exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]" for I-765.
category.example: Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]

form.description: For US, the USCIS form number exactly as USCIS writes it, e.g. "I-765"; "i765" and "I765" do not match.

office.description: For US, the USCIS office exactly as the processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Service Center Operations (SCOPS)", "National Benefits Center", or a field office such as "Houston TX".

name: get_processing_time

basis.description: What value measures, as the source states it

category_notes.description: The source's own note on the category, or null

unit.description: Unit of value as the source states it, e.g. "Months", "weeks", or "Days"

title: Get processing time
